answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops fakes. An agent locks 50 units; release needs a 20-epoch fingerprint of varied peers and work. A farm copying a script across 100 identities repeats a ridge-shaped pattern, so escrow stays locked. Forging 100 costs 5,000 units and 4,000 hours, versus one bond if honest. Honest agents recover the deposit undiluted. Hollow shells, porous as karst, never release. A Sybil at the nadir earns nothing.
